events.verdict: Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) cleanly dislodges the ball from Wiggins (GSW) and the contact with his back is marginal.
Podziemski (GSW) releases away from Joe (OKC) to retrieve the rebound.
Podziemski (GSW) engages and then quickly disengages with Joe (OKC) as Joe moves to set the pick on the perimeter.
Kuminga's (GSW) momentum carries him forwards and he inadvertently steps on Hartenstein's (OKC) foot.
Podziemski (GSW) and Dort (OKC) briefly engage and then quickly disengage with one another as Dort moves to set the pick.
Waters III (GSW) is in a legal guarding position defending Joe (OKC) when Podziemski (GSW) makes clean contact with the ball.
Podziemski (GSW) dives to the floor and makes clean contact with the ball and any ensuing contact with Joe (OKC) is incidental.
Dort (OKC) overtly launches into Podziemski (GSW) and dislodges him from his defensive position.
Green (GSW) establishes a screening position in Wallace's (OKC) path and does not deliver illegal contact.
Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) collapses both arms to brace for the ensuing marginal contact with Kuminga (GSW).
Hield (GSW) initiates illegal contact with Hartenstein (OKC) as he secures the rebound.
Kuminga (GSW) illegally wraps an arm around Hartenstein's (OKC) opposite-side hip during the throw-in.
Dort (OKC) legally contests Wiggins' (GSW) jump shot attempt.
Kuminga (GSW) briefly has an arm placed around Gilgeous-Alexander's (OKC) side, which he removes as Gilgeous-Alexander receives the pass.
Hield (GSW) initiates illegal contact to Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC).
Podziemski (GSW) inadvertently steps on Joe's (OKC) foot as the two players briefly engage.
Dort (OKC) legally contests Wiggins' (GSW) layup attempt.
Waters III (GSW) commits a take foul on Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC).
Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) legally contests Waters III's (GSW) jump shot attempt.
